text.description_html:
Stainless Steel Wrap Around Plate for 1-3/8 Thick Doors with 2 Additional Countersunk Holes on Each Side

This is a 70-CW-630 stainless steel blank wrap around plate for 1-3/8” thick door that will be drilled with 2 additional countersunk holes on each side, 4” on center, from the back side of the plate. Includes 4ea. #8 x 3/4” Phillips truss head trim screws.

Features and Specifications of the Stainless Steel Wrap Around Plate for 1-3/8 Thick Doors:

  • Material: 22 ga. Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Length: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/4"
  • Edge Width (Door Thickness): 1-3/8"
  • Includes 4ea. #8 x 3/4” Phillips truss head trim screws

Sold individually. Made to order. NOT Returnable.
